name: get-forwards-method-path-query-and-headers
description: GET /2.0/folders/0?fields=name is replayed to the API with the same method, path, query and application headers; Host/Connection/MULE_* are dropped (copy-headers). The API's JSON and custom response headers come back unchanged with status 200.

source.reference: proxying-a-rest-api/src/main/app/proxying-a-rest-api.xml (http:listener path=/*, http:request method=#[http.method] path=#[http.request.path] query-params=#[http.query.params], copy-headers removes Host, Content-Length, http.*, MULE_*, Connection, transfer-encoding); proxying-a-rest-api/README.md
